title: Remember the immortal snail hypothetical? My friend and I turned it into a free game called Immortal Dale!
author: TheRico01
selftext:
Immortal Dale is a retro-style side-scrolling game that my friend and I created as a passion project using Tesana.

Inspired by the infamous immortal snail hypothetical, you play as Dale, an immortal man being hunted by a super-intelligent snail. Your goal is to survive 10 increasingly challenging levels while avoiding obstacles and slowing down the snail. One touch and it's game over!

This was an idea we came up with a couple of years ago, and we finally decided to bring it to life. We spent several hours designing, refining, and playtesting the game with the help of AI.

It's completely free to play in your browser, with no downloads required!

We're open to constructive feedback, suggestions, and questions about the AI-assisted development process.

We hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed creating it!

Play it free in your browser: https://tesana.com/game/immortal-dale
